items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Howell Harding, you said, was from out of Texas. [INTERVIEWEE] He's out of Dallas. Out of Dallas. Whatever happened? Still there. He's still there? He's not in the music community.

ctx.x: Because I was selling the tickets. She sold most of the tickets, man. She wanted to know if I was coming.

I couldn't miss it. I don't think I've ever missed one of your concerts. Oh, gosh. Well, some of these fellas that played with him, I know almost nothing about. We talked about Billy Douglas and Alvin Alcorn. Howell Harding, you said, was from out of Texas.
He's out of Dallas. Out of Dallas. Whatever happened? Still there. He's still there? He's not in the music community.
